Author: Melody Pendragon
Name: PvP TopPlates
Description:
Draws stabilized PvP player HP, shield, and MP bars in Dalamud's foreground UI layer so terrain and map geometry cannot cover them.

Use /ptop to configure.
Punchline: Keeps stable PvP HP and MP bars above the 3D world.
Changelog: Adds a configurable MP bar and frame-rate-independent screen-space stabilization to reduce plate jitter.
